title: BrowserActedData
description: data of browser.acted (registry 1.7.0, ADR-0051): one step of an agentic browser session, written after the worker answered, so the Browser panel shows only what happened (HR-1, BR-09). verdict done: code allowed the action and the worker ran it; refused: reason says why and nothing ran; gated: a commit waiting at a T3 gate (its approval.requested follows); committed: the outbox ran a commit a person approved, after its data.transfer (BR-05). frame is the masked screenshot after the step (origin browser), null when none. host is the page's host after the step; chars counts typed characters (a type action only). Never typed text, a full URL or page text (BR-13). authz null: a commit's authorisation is on its approval.resolved and data.transfer.
